userStories.title: Behavioral patterns panel + adapter wiring
acceptanceCriteria: adapter.py exposes a PanelInputs.behavioral_signals field summing the per-session BehavioralSignals across the week; the behavioral-patterns panel renders counts plus up to two concrete excerpts per signal, each excerpt clipped to <=120 chars.
Both renderers cite the primary source per signal (e.g., 'arXiv 2509.10402 CodeChat') inline in small footnote text.
When zero new signals fired in the week (e.g., empty profile), the panel renders 'No behavioral patterns captured this week.' rather than an empty table.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Augmentation/automation balance + cadence panels
acceptanceCriteria: The balance panel renders the augmentation/automation/mixed share for the week with the Anthropic Economic Index ~52%/45% augmentation/automation industry anchor; the cadence panel renders weekday streak + high-adopter spectrum position from cadence-detector with the arXiv 2509.19708 anchor.
When aug_auto is unavailable for the week (all rows NULL because no API key), the balance panel renders 'Classifier unavailable for this week.' instead of misleading 0/0/0 percentages.
When cadence's window has zero substantive sessions, the cadence panel renders 'No substantive sessions in the last 21 days.' and omits the high-adopter label.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Repeat-task radar + verification calibration panels
acceptanceCriteria: The repeat-task radar renders each RepeatTask from detect_repeats with its occurrences count, estimated_minutes_per_occurrence, and a 'Could become a skill' tag; the verification-calibration panel breaks down source-check vs test-run vs spot-check vs blanket-accept counts.
Both panels cite their primary sources inline (OpenAI ChatGPT usage paper + Anthropic Skills for repeats; Sonar + Stack Overflow 2025 + automation-bias lit for calibration).
When detect_repeats returns an empty list, the radar panel renders 'No repeat tasks detected this week.' (not an empty list with a misleading header).
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Specification, context engineering, knowledge-gap panels
acceptanceCriteria: The specification-adoption panel renders the share of sessions in the week that opened with a spec block (Section 11 signal), with the Woodward + SpecKit + Sean Grove citations inline.
The context-engineering-depth panel renders presence/use of CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / Projects / skills (Section 11 scaffolding-artifact signal) with DORA 2025 + Anthropic Skills citations.

The knowledge-gap distribution panel renders counts across the four arXiv-2501.11709 categories; a session with zero detected gaps still contributes a zero to each category (no silent drops) and the panel renders 'No knowledge gaps detected this week.' only when every category is zero.
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest

userStories.title: Tool/agent ladder + refined cost-effectiveness panel
acceptanceCriteria: The tool/agent ladder panel renders the user's max ladder rung observed in the week (prompt-only / tools-on / skills / hooks / subagents) with Anthropic Skills/hooks/subagents + OpenAI harness-engineering citations.

The refined cost-effectiveness panel renders 'You spent $X on <higher-tier model> for tasks <lower-tier model> could have done = $Y overspend' using a counterfactual rule documented in praxis/models_advisor/advisor.py (rule must be deterministic and unit-tested).
When the cost ledger has no entries for the week, the cost-effectiveness panel renders 'No cost data this week.' rather than $0 overspend (which would falsely imply optimality).
Typecheck passes: uv run mypy praxis
Tests pass: uv run pytest
